name: Envoy to the Horde
summary: Envoy to the Horde marks a pivotal diplomatic journey for the blood elves following the defeat of the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir. Entrusted with a missive from Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron, an emissary travels from Quel'Thalas to the Undercity to deliver proof of Sin'dorei strength directly to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

sections.title: Proving Sin'dorei Worth
sections.body: Before this mission, prospective allies in the Horde harbored grave doubts regarding the blood elves' martial prowess. Besieged by the Scourge and struggling to pacify the Ghostlands, Quel'Thalas appeared fragile and incapable of resolving its own domestic crises. The downfall of Dar'Khan Drathir completely upended this dynamic. By eliminating the arch-traitor who orchestrated the fall of the Sunwell, the Sin'dorei demonstrated they could reclaim their homelands and enter the Horde not as desperate supplicants, but as powerful equals.

sections.title: Audience with the Banshee Queen
sections.body: Lor'themar Theron directs his messenger southwest across the blighted lands to the Undercity, the subterranean capital of the Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, once the Ranger-General of Silvermoon who gave her life defending Quel'Thalas, serves as the blood elves' greatest advocate among the Horde's leadership. Presenting Lor'themar's letter to her confirms Dar'Khan's demise and paves the way for further overtures to Warchief Thrall in distant Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why is Lor'themar Theron sending an emissary to Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Sylvanas Windrunner is already sympathetic to the plight of Quel'Thalas and acts as the blood elves' primary sponsor within the Horde. Delivering proof of Dar'Khan Drathir's death allows her to advocate for their formal admittance into the Horde with undeniable proof of their strength.

faq.q: Who was Dar'Khan Drathir and why does his death matter?
faq.answer: Dar'Khan Drathir was the high elf traitor who sold out Silvermoon's magical defenses to Arthas and the Scourge during the Third War. Eliminating him in the Ghostlands broke the Scourge's local command and proved the Sin'dorei could handle their own domestic threats.

faq.q: Where does this diplomatic mission lead next?
aliases: what quest comes after envoy to the horde
where do I go after undercity
faq.answer: Upon receiving Lor'themar's letter, Sylvanas directs the emissary across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, specifically to Orgrimmar, to present the blood elves' case before Warchief Thrall and the orcish leadership.

faq.q: Why were the Horde hesitant to ally with the blood elves?
aliases: why did horde doubt blood elves
faq.answer: The leaders of the Horde doubted whether the blood elves could contribute meaningfully to an alliance when they appeared unable to drive out the remnants of the Scourge from their own ruined kingdom.

faq.q: How does this missive affect relations with the Darkspear trolls?
aliases: what does this have to do with trolls
faq.answer: Sylvanas notes that Lor'themar's letter contains additional tidings designed to soothe long-standing animosity between the elves and the trolls, improving relations as the blood elves seek entry into the Horde.

faq.q: What is Sylvanas's personal stake in this news?
aliases: why does sylvanas care about darkhan
faq.answer: In life, Sylvanas was the Ranger-General of Silvermoon who fell fighting the Scourge brought in by Dar'Khan's treason. Hearing that the traitor has met his end is deeply satisfying to her both politically and personally.

angles.text: This mission forms the cornerstone of the Sin'dorei petition to join the Horde, providing the leverage needed to secure a formal alliance with Orgrimmar and Undercity.
The Forsaken view the blood elves as crucial northern allies, and Sylvanas personally champions their inclusion in the greater Horde council.
Centuries of bitter conflict between elves and trolls make this diplomatic step fraught, requiring Lor'themar to include delicate concessions to appease the Darkspear.
